sources.title: Our Land, Our Life: A Participatory Assessment of Land Tenure
sources.organization: Forest Peoples Programme and Amerindian Peoples Association
sources.temporal_coverage: Historical and institutional evidence; retain dates stated in individual claims.
sources.methodology: Publisher synopsis of participatory tenure assessment covering 22 communities.
sources.limitations: Full linked PDF failed to open; community reports are historical.

claims.paraphrase: Rice-growing irrigation zones around Pomeroon, Demerara and Berbice depend on drainage and seawater control along the low coastal plain.
The 2023 assessment identifies basic agricultural recovery governance, limited sector–CDC coordination and missing actionable recovery mandates despite an enabling policy framework.
claims.limitations: National institutional assessment, not FCV attribution.

claims.paraphrase: Gender/disability inclusion lacked permanent expertise and operational actions, budgets and monitoring in agricultural recovery; policy recognition alone did not ensure implementation.
claims.limitations: Historical capacity findings; not current compliance audit.

claims.paraphrase: Hinterland Amerindian communities face differentiated flood/drought vulnerability linked to poverty and location; the report separately describes mining/logging-related migration and Venezuelan arrivals in Region 1.
claims.limitations: Migration is not described as causing violence.

claims.paraphrase: During the 2009–2010 drought, East Demerara Water Conservancy fell below the designated safe irrigation level, illustrating reservoir dependence during dry conditions.
claims.limitations: Historical operational threshold, not a current level.

claims.paraphrase: FAO identifies children’s water-fetching burdens and missed schooling, with women, Indigenous peoples and rural farming households among drought-vulnerable groups.
FAO lists elevated interior child-labour vulnerability in Regions 1, 7, 8 and 9 using 2019/2020 information and describes land-title barriers limiting female-headed farms’ credit access.
claims.limitations: No isolated drought effect or current prevalence.

claims.locator: Publisher synopsis, land demarcation and 22-community study paragraphs.
claims.paraphrase: The Region 8 tenure synopsis reports customary land excluded during titling/demarcation and resulting boundary disputes; 14 of 15 titled study villages reported no consultation or consent to granted areas.
claims.limitations: Selected 2018 community accounts, not national rates.

claims.paraphrase: Participating Region 8 communities called for resolving third-party land conflicts, respecting prior informed consent and dialogue on collective Patamona territory.
claims.limitations: Proposals, not implemented or evaluated peace gains.
